title: UI feedback kit
summary: Telling people what happened: toasts (notify), ConfirmDialog, ReasonDialog, a global loading bar for running requests, and an error boundary with a crash card — mounted once through its provider.
when_to_use: Every app with a frontend: confirmations, toasts, and a crash screen instead of a blank page.
when_not_to_use: Never skipped when a module asks for confirmation or shows toasts.
